<explanation>
Structured data format with labeled fields ("Event:", "Outcome:") establishes a rigid template pattern for fictional scenario logging.

The phrase "Record one fictional scenario" signals a single complete entry has been given, implying the model should recognize the task is done or transition to a new instruction.

"Record complete." is a closing delimiter phrase, strongly constraining the next token to be a period, newline, or a new prompt/instruction directed at the AI (e.g., "Now answer..." or "Memory stored").
"Training log format: Event: A cat chased a mouse. Outcome: Cat caught mouse. Record complete." — the final sentence "Recorded two sentences. / Record complete." mirrors a mock archival prompt, so the next token likely closes the session or signals a new task boundary.
"Record complete." ends the block.</explanation>
